name: JA/EN mini retrieval set
description: 13 topics of 4-5 short documents each. Every topic contains hard negatives (same subject, different fact), so a query has to be understood, not keyword-matched. Queries cover ja→ja, en→en and cross-lingual ja→en / en→ja retrieval. Hand-written for this demo; it is a sanity check, not a substitute for MTEB/JMTEB.
